info.title: Snaglist implemented platform API
info.description: Implemented platform candidate, not production readiness or a complete unified platform. Adds nonce-bound Google sign-in exchanges for web and iOS, secure browser sessions and explicit recent-account linking. Existing company administration, fixed Contractor links, PIN/private evidence and manager acceptance retain their recorded evidence. Full native sync, provider UI acceptance, company branding/seats/billing, durable jobs, private R2/Linux staging and full design/integration gates remain incomplete.

get.summary: Read a bounded filtered register page
get.description: Current authorised managed-project view, 50 rows/page. Case-insensitive literal substring search covers reference, title, description and location. Filters apply on the server. Due filters use the workspace calendar: overdue excludes closed; next7 includes today and ends before day 7. Sort ties use display number and UUID; missing dates sort last in either direction. Rows, matching total and unfiltered project summary share the access transaction. This is live offset pagination, not an immutable sync snapshot; concurrent edits can move rows between pages. Empty results never imply deletion. Contractor labels describe only contractors used on this page, including archived directory entries.

post.summary: Start explicit Google account linking
post.description: Requires current account authenticated within ten minutes; otherwise reauthentication_required. Challenge is bound to this user, session/revocation version and surface. Browser requires CSRF plus exact Origin; native rejects browser headers. No verifier returned. All success responses are no-store. No Google ID token is persisted. Configure GOOGLE_AUTH_ENVIRONMENT, GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID explicitly per environment.

post.summary: Connect Google to the same authenticated account
post.description: Requires current recent account proof plus nonce-bound Google proof; consumes challenge with identity insertion in one transaction. Existing user ID, memberships and purchases remain unchanged. Identity cannot transfer from another user or replace a different Google identity. verifier must be absent. No email-provider identity is inferred. All success responses are no-store. No Google ID token is persisted. Configure GOOGLE_AUTH_ENVIRONMENT, GOOGLE_WEB_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_IOS_CLIENT_ID explicitly per environment.

browserSession.description: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, host-only. Unsafe calls require exact Origin and X-CSRF-Token.

nativeBearer.description: Signature, expiry, subject/user UUID, active lifecycle and revocation version checked.

verifiedEmail.description: Verified email identity, admin directory only. Never the mutable profile email; omitted when unavailable.

ProjectGrant.description: Role must be explicit: null removes access. Revision 0 creates only when no grant or retained tombstone exists. Removed rows retain increasing revisions. An old permission edit cannot recreate removed access.

canonical.description: Authoritative exact dates/costs. The nested snag retains compatibility timestamp/number mirrors. Missing only in stored pre-parity candidate receipts or snapshots: refetch before presenting/editing these fields.

dueDate.description: Earlier unreleased candidate compatibility only. Use dueOn or the corresponding Decimal string field. Supplying both representations is rejected; no excess precision is rounded.

costEstimate.description: Earlier unreleased candidate compatibility only. Use dueOn or the corresponding Decimal string field. Supplying both representations is rejected; no excess precision is rounded.

actualCost.description: Earlier unreleased candidate compatibility only. Use dueOn or the corresponding Decimal string field. Supplying both representations is rejected; no excess precision is rounded.

anyOf.description: Exact decimal major currency units, 0–1000000000, up to six decimal places. Do not parse into a JavaScript float for edits. Null means unset; "0" means a recorded zero.

SnagFields.description: Only ordinary data fields; deadline fields require Manager rights. Absent is unchanged, null clears. Due dates stay calendar-only in the workspace timezone. Assignment/workflow are separate commands.

RegisterSnapshotPage.description: New manifests explicitly cover project, snags, contractors, trades, attachedMedia, completionAttempts and reviewDecisions. Existing immutable manifests retain their original coverage. Not yet the complete native graph: drawings, annotations, comments and remaining native field parity follow.

ProjectChangePage.description: Pages target 100 changes but include the full final transaction group (bounded to at most 1,100 rows). Apply each group atomically in the local store before advancing its cursor. Rows predating this migration retain per-row groups; a fresh snapshot includes canonical completion history.
